messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to help you introduce your new teacher to みなさん.

1. True or False: Your teacher has a cat named ねこ (neko).
2. True or False: 先生 can juggle three balls.
3. True or False: Your teacher ate a whole pizza once.
4. 本当 or False: Your 先生 has been to three countries.
5. True or False: Your teacher's favorite 色 is blue.
6. True or False: 先生 can ride a bike.
7. True or False: Your 先生 speaks two languages.
8. True or False: 先生 has a twin.
9. True or False: Your 先生's new favorite food is sushi.
10. True or False: 先生 played a sport. 一緒に enjoy this 楽しい game with 先生!
